title: cscc log retention immutable logs
linkedin:
> At least 18 months.

Control 2-11-2 sets the retention floor for critical systems event logs, in line with relevant legislative and regulatory requirements. Retention alone isn't enough: 2-11-1-5 requires logs to be maintained and protected against unauthorised access, tampering, illegitimate modification, and deletion, so you need write-once storage with a retention lock rather than an ordinary bucket an administrator could clear.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/cscc-log-retention-immutable-logs/
